name: where-winds-meet-hutuo-nov-13
note: رسمي: PlayStation Blog post by Eric Zheng, Head of Where Winds Meet Publishing (27 Oct 15:01Z): Hutuo, a new region, launches 13 Nov with the first global anniversary update; over 100 million players in August. Footage: the post's three official Hutuo clips (1280x720, silent, 3.6/7.0/6.8 s), each from 0.8 s, cropped 1120x630 at x 160 to drop the ESRB badge, shown at native width (downscaled to 1080) over a blurred copy (showcase layout, no enlargement); the reveal video itself is a YouTube embed, not used. Silent footage, so our everyday bed.
lines:
